import re

def parse(lines):
    head_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<pad> *)(?P<marker>[!*]) \[(?P<branch>[^\]]+)\](?:\s+(?P<subject>.*))?$')
    sep_re = re.compile(r'^-+$')
    commit_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<flags>[ +*\-]*?) ?\[(?P<ref>[^\]]+)\](?:\s+(?P<subject>.*))?$')
    branches, blines = [], []
    commits, clines = [], []
    skip = []
    names = []
    width = 0
    after = False
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        if not after and sep_re.match(line):
            after = True
            width = len(line)
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if not after:
            m = head_re.match(line)
            if m:
                names.append(m.group('branch'))
                branches.append({'Column': len(m.group('pad')) + 1, 'Marker': m.group('marker'), 'Branch': m.group('branch'), 'Subject': (m.group('subject') or '').strip()})
                blines.append(i)
            continue
        m = commit_re.match(line)
        if m:
            flags = m.group('flags')
            if width:
                flags = flags.ljust(width)[:width]
            inb = [names[k] for k, c in enumerate(flags) if k < len(names) and c in '+*-']
            commits.append({'Flags': flags.rstrip(), 'Ref': m.group('ref'), 'Subject': (m.group('subject') or '').strip(), 'Branches': ', '.join(inb)})
            clines.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if branches:
        blocks.append({'name': 'branches', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': blines, 'records': branches})
    if commits:
        blocks.append({'name': 'commits', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': clines, 'records': commits})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
